policyQuestions.question: May a forward PAPER record alone (e.g. 20+ trades positive at 1.5x costs, or 30+ trades positive) trigger a trade suggestion or a BUY wording, before the rule passes its history test?
policyQuestions.where: ignition-watch.mjs early paper alerts ("Ride it only with the minimum 1,000 USD"); intraday-radar.mjs graduation ("BUY: PROVEN on paper", batch-1 X01); octopus "may be considered as buys" (X04)
policyQuestions.note: Not decided in this package. CLAUDE.md section 9 currently allows plain BUYs only for the owner's lanes.

policyQuestions.question: May the per-stock "past-trade check" (okEv: 30+ out-of-sample trades on the stock >= +0.4%, or 15+ >= +1.5% and half won) admit engine BUY candidates when focus is off, given that its only test (hunting-lab persistence) was inconclusive and pointed the wrong way?
